title: calc-chain: lemma28 counting bound from a Markov bound and three norm lemmas
intent: Reduce the counting bound (#A ^ k) / 2 ≤ #(l k m ε f A) first to the Markov bound lemma28_markov, then close the norm estimate it leaves open by a chain of three inequalities, one named lemma per link: lemma28_part_one (per-x Marcinkiewicz-Zygmund), lemma28_part_two (translate-norm bound) and lemma28_end (final arithmetic).

parent.name: lemma28
parent.statement:
lemma lemma28 (hε : 0 < ε) (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hk : (64 : ℝ) * m / ε ^ 2 ≤ k) :
    (#A ^ k : ℝ) / 2 ≤ #(l k m ε f A)

children.name: lemma28_markov
children.statement:
lemma lemma28_markov (hε : 0 < ε) (hm : 1 ≤ m)
    (h : ∑ a ∈ A ^^ k,
        (‖fun x : G ↦ ∑ i : Fin k, f (x - a i) - (k • (mu A ∗ᵈ f)) x‖_[2 * m] ^ (2 * m) : ℝ) ≤
      1 / 2 * (k * ε * ‖f‖_[2 * m]) ^ (2 * m) * #A ^ k) :
    (#A ^ k : ℝ) / 2 ≤ #(l k m ε f A)
children.closed_by: my_other_markov applied to the hypothesis, then rewriting and pow_le_pow_iff_left₀
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: A Markov-type bound: (1 / 2) · #A ^ k ≤ #(l k m ε f A) from a half-norm hypothesis.

children.name: lemma28_part_one
children.statement:
lemma lemma28_part_one (hm : 1 ≤ m) (x : G) :
    ∑ a ∈ A ^^ k, ‖∑ i, f (x - a i) - (k • (mu A ∗ᵈ f)) x‖ ^ (2 * m) ≤
      (8 * m) ^ m * k ^ (m - 1) *
        ∑ a ∈ A ^^ k, ∑ i, ‖f (x - a i) - (mu A ∗ᵈ f) x‖ ^ (2 * m)
children.closed_by: marcinkiewicz_zygmund_piFinset inside a calc, then gcongr/norm_num and rewriting
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: Per-x Marcinkiewicz-Zygmund: the 2m-norm of a k-fold sum is bounded by the sum of the per-coordinate norms.

children.name: lemma28_part_two
children.statement:
lemma lemma28_part_two (hm : 1 ≤ m) (hA : A.Nonempty) :
    (8 * m) ^ m * k ^ (m - 1) * ∑ a ∈ A ^^ k, ∑ i, ‖τ (a i) f - mu A ∗ᵈ f‖_[2 * m] ^ (2 * m) ≤
      (8 * m) ^ m * k ^ (m - 1) * ∑ _a ∈ A ^^ k, ∑ _i : Fin k, (2 * ‖f‖_[2 * m]) ^ (2 * m)
children.closed_by: dLpNorm_sub_le, dLpNorm_translate and dLpNorm_ddconv_le chained with trans, then dL1Norm_mu
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: Translate-norm bound: each translated-coordinate 2m-norm is at most (2 · ‖f‖_[2 * m]) ^ (2 * m).

children.name: lemma28_end
children.closed_by: a calc of arithmetic closed by ring/ring_nf/gcongr/norm_num/omega
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: Final arithmetic: the accumulated bound is at most 1 / 2 · (k * ε) ^ (2 * m) · ∑ ‖f‖ ^ (2 * m) · #A ^ k.

applicability.goal_shape: A lower bound on the size of a Finset selected by a norm condition, #(l k m ε f A) ≥ (1 / 2) · #A ^ k, where l k m ε f A is the set of k-tuples a ∈ A ^^ k whose Lp-norm ‖∑ f(x - a i) - (k • (mu A ∗ᵈ f)) x‖_[2 * m] is small (LProp, lines 237-238).
applicability.use_when: The theorem is a counting / large-deviation bound reducible to (i) a Markov-type bound turning the counting claim into a norm bound, then (ii) a chain of inequalities each expressible as its own self-contained named lemma (a pointwise concentration bound, a translate-norm bound, an arithmetic end).
applicability.avoid_when: The steps do not compose into one chain (different measure spaces, mismatched norms), or a side condition one lemma needs (A nonempty, ε > 0, k large) is not delivered by the preceding step; or the arithmetic end is entangled with the analytic steps.
